_readme: Handpicked audio library. Drop files in public/sfx and public/music, then add an
entry here describing each one. The render/director step reads this so Claude can
place the RIGHT sound at the RIGHT moment (SFX on cuts/emphasis, music as a bed
ducked under the voice). 'tags' + 'use' guide the choice; 'file' is relative to public/.
SFX = the v3 kit (public/sfx/v3, synthesised by make-kit.mjs there): soft, airy UI sounds
for a talking-head reel — felt more than heard. Every file is level-matched to -20 LUFS
(max momentary), so 'volume' is the recommended <Audio volume> in the current mix
(voice x2.8, bed 0.32): cues land ~20-25 dB under the voice. 'hitMs' = where the sound
lands inside the file (start the cue that much before the moment). WorldReel places these
itself via src/auto/sound.ts; see src/auto/SOUND.md. 'sfx_legacy' = the old stock files,
kept only so older renders/props still resolve — hot and generic, don't pick them.

sfx.use: soft filtered-air swish (0.67s, peaks at 0.26s) — a camera move / scene change, centred; darkens as it lands
same air swish panned in from the right — camera travelling right / content entering from the right
same air swish panned in from the left — camera travelling left / content entering from the left
tiny glassy UI tick (0.16s) — a checkmark landing, a step completing, a toggle flipping, a cursor click
the same tick two semitones up — the NEXT check/step right after tick-a (never the same sample twice in a row)
round soft bloop (0.3s) — a card/object arriving on screen when there's no camera move to carry it
three soft low-profile key taps (0.42s) — ONCE as a terminal/code/prompt starts typing; never loop it into a typing track
one soft key press + release (0.22s) — a keyboard shortcut / kbd moment
gentle two-note rising chime, D5→A5 (0.7s) — the payoff: the link/result lands, 'get it here', done
low felt thump with a soft knock (0.55s) — a big number settling, a stat, a one-word punch; not a cinematic boom
0.9s filtered-air rise that stops ON the hit — into a reveal/comparison after a pause; at most one per video

sfx_legacy.use: LEGACY stock whoosh (5.6s file, ~1.1s lead silence, -14.8 LUFS) — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock click — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock pop (4.9s file) — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock riser (-7.4 LUFS, ~1.8s lead silence) — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock typing loop (4.8s) — kept for old renders only
LEGACY stock thud — brick-walled (-0.8 LUFS, DC offset); kept for old renders only, never use

music.use: drifting, spacious pads — cold-open / futuristic / research-frontier scripts; stays out of the way
darker evening mood — drama, bans, layoffs, 'something changed' scripts; pairs with red/violet accents
safe neutral bed — explainers, tool walkthroughs, anything that shouldn't editorialize the mood
rainy-window cozy — reflective / 'here's what I actually think' scripts; slowest of the set
study-beats focus loop — install / setup / how-to / 'watch it work' tool demos; steady pulse keeps typing beats moving
warmest + most upbeat of the set — wins, launches, 'this is great' recommendations; pairs with green/orange accents
